exposure: Gestational age categories: extremely preterm, very preterm, moderate to late preterm, and term deliveries
cohort: All singleton deliveries (243,363) occurring between 1991 and 2014 at a single tertiary medical center.
finding: The risk for long-term ophthalmic-related hospitalization decreases gradually as gestational age at birth increases.
